text: The gate’s open!\nAnd the Wooloo that was there...[VAR 0114(0005)]
It was tackling the fence pretty hard earlier.\nYou don’t think it actually broke through there,\r\ndo you?[VAR 0114(0005)]

But it’s off-limits!
Nobody’s supposed to go in there!\c
I remember the professor’s granddaughter went
in once, and she came back in a real state...\c
And that was nothing compared to the earful
she got from the professor afterward![VAR 0114(0005)]
Right? Even if we’re not supposed to, this is the\nkind of scene where you simply have to do\r\nwhat’s needed![VAR 0114(0005)]

Right...
No one wants to get in trouble, least of all me.\c
But deep down you want to save that Pokémon,
too, don’t you?[VAR 0114(0005)]
Hope you’re ready for anything, because we’re\ngoing in, [VAR 0100(0000)]![VAR 0114(0005)]
Come on, [VAR 0100(0000)]!\nWe can’t just leave that Pokémon on its own!
